column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm,” and capitalizes “my Rock.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness,” and מִשְׂגַּבִּי (“my stronghold”) “My high tower.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you have known him… regarded him” is rendered “You take knowledge of him… are mindful of him.”
Close to the Hebrew; וּתְהֻמֵּם (“rout them”) is rendered “destroy them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sons of foreignness” is rendered “foreigners.”
Close to the Hebrew; שָׁוְא (“emptiness”) is rendered “vain words,” and “deception” “falsehood.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a lyre of ten” is rendered “a harp of ten strings.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the evil sword” is rendered “the deadly sword.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sons of foreignness” is rendered “foreigners,” and “emptiness” “lying words.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who” is rendered “That… may be,” and כְזָוִיֹּת (“corner pillars”) “as pillars.”
Close to the Hebrew; “no breach and no going out” is rendered “no breaking in or going out.”
